public.text: Household, spousal, and family relationships are included within the Client Registry. These relationships may be sensitive, contested, temporary, culturally variable, or maintained by other social or civil registries.
public.suggestedRevision: Make relationship management conditional and purpose-specific. Require relationship type, source, verification status, validity period, consent or legal basis, sensitivity classification, and correction process.
